name: AAAR-1.0
description: AAAR-1.0 is a benchmark dataset designed to evaluate large language models on expertise-intensive research tasks such as equation inference, experiment design, paper weakness identification, and review critique. It is explicitly research-oriented and mirrors primary activities researchers engage in daily.
reputation: A relatively new research benchmark from the paper, with growing interest in evaluating LLMs on expert-level scientific reasoning tasks but not yet a widely standardized community benchmark.
notes: Focuses on research-oriented tasks requiring deep domain expertise; will be iterated to new versions.
